source.author: PingYou Ltd
source.method: Finite whole-owner directed face-port return with joint host-boundary reconstruction.
source.attribution_note: PingYou Ltd constructed this finite boundary return. The infinite FCC rhombicuboctahedron packing is classical, reported by Betke and Henk, Densest Lattice Packings of 3-Polytopes, Section5. No claim of inventing that infinite lattice.

construction.name: finite_rhombicuboctahedron_face_return
construction.coordinate_convention: Exact centers and vertices are twice native unit-edge coordinates. Canonical vertices are signed permutations of (1+sqrt(2),1,1); the support at a normal with k nonzero entries is k+sqrt(2).
construction.classical_start: (2+sqrt(2))*D3; integer words have even coordinate sum
construction.physical_operation: Select whole owners from the classical FCC lattice at a marked cell center, face, edge or vertex. Keep one actual directed face-separator for each pair and every host wall. Reconstruct all owner translations jointly. At each continued return, assign pair ports to realized separating faces before reconstructing the entire next configuration. A recorded boundary exchange retires a wall controller, proposes a complete new owner through one of a retained owner's twelve FCC contact ports, and solves the entire common completion with all retained pair ports fixed. Every owner remains whole and retains the canonical frame.
construction.native_clearance: From the exact ideal packing, dilate centers by1+1/500000 and take host scale=(1+1/500000)*exact_nominal+1/500000. Unit owners are retained.
construction.new_configuration: The realized finite geometry differs from its initial FCC window under every canonical signed-coordinate symmetry and common translation.

contribution.method: New finite constructions by PingYou Ltd. Truncated-cube and rhombicuboctahedron boundary returns retain complete shells and their shared closure equations. Truncated-dodecahedron and truncated-icosahedron constructions replace complete credited donor cells, then jointly move the resulting pieces using the newly exposed contacts and all host walls. Controller-owner deletion gives further complete arrangements. Source frames, directed separators and every reconstruction step are retained. The archive retains complete native coordinates, explicit physical construction decoders, original source and donor credits, independent geometry and construction reviews, and SHA256 manifests. All 32 witnesses pass the unmodified upstream floating checker and exact certifier.
